day_line: The sun on a Horse day. Bright and lively: good for outings and big get-togethers, easy to burn out by evening.

lines.Yang Wood: Saturday brings out your fun side. Plan the outing; leave room for a nap.
lines.Yin Wood: Your ideas spark today. Share the weekend plan and let others add one thing.
lines.Yang Fire: Your crowd is loud and warm today. Join in, and drink water between rounds.
lines.Yin Fire: Someone shines brighter today. Cheer them on; your turn comes soon.
lines.Yang Earth: A slow morning helps today. Read on the sofa before the errands start.
lines.Yin Earth: Family takes care of you today. Let them cook; you do the washing up.
lines.Yang Metal: The heat is on a bit today. Do the chores early, then find some aircon.
lines.Yin Metal: Your effort gets praised today. Smile and say thanks; no need to explain.
lines.Yang Water: A good deal turns up today. Compare twice, buy once, keep the receipt.
lines.Yin Water: Simple fun wins today. A picnic in the park beats a pricey brunch.
